value.description: A heavy rifle designed to be wielded by a combat mech for use against other mechs other other heavy military hardware.\n\nThe weapon is too large to be wielded by a regular human, even if they could somehow manage the terrible recoil.

A hugely oversized multi-barrel machine gun. It's unwieldy for regular human and clearly made to be mounted on some sort of vehicle or mech. The weapon is made for laying down supressive fire and does not require aiming, and thanks to the belt-fed ammo the weapon fire for a long time without reloading.

A heavy rocket launcher originally designed to be welded to a combat mech for use against other mechs other other heavy military hardware.\n\nThe weapon is too large to be wielded by a regular human, even if they could somehow manage the terrible recoil.

These huge javelins are primarily made for throwing, but they also make for acceptable melee weapons. They take a long time to throw, but one hit can do devastating damage. Too large to be wielded by a regular human.
These large rocks have been crudely chiseled for throwing at enemies. Too heavy to be wielded by a regular human.
